name: Filler skip
author: Slim Cognito
description: Hold L1+R1 to skip the Endako Clank section, the Giant Clank battle at Dobbo and the split Aranos Prison sections; optional instant Electrolyzer and Infiltrator puzzles and a Yeedil Hypnomatic skip.

settings.name: Hold time
settings.description: Seconds to hold L1+R1 to skip a section.

settings.name: Endako: Clank section
settings.description: Offer the skip while Clank is on his own on Endako.

settings.name: Dobbo: Giant Clank (Dobbo Orbit)
settings.description: Offer the skip while walking up to the man who sends you to orbit.

settings.name: Aranos Prison: split sections
settings.description: Offer the skip in each Clank and Ratchet section until they are reunited.

settings.name: Instant Electrolyzer puzzles
settings.description: Using the Electrolyzer on a panel solves its puzzle at once.

settings.name: Instant Infiltrator puzzles
settings.description: Using the Infiltrator on a lock solves its puzzle at once.

settings.name: Yeedil Hypnomatic Skip
settings.description: Hold L1+R1 by the first Megacorp Vendor on the bridge to turn on the Swingshot targets, and by the large door to the teleporter to open it.
